term: actual ultimate source relative to being-through
definition: RootAt m w y means y exists at w and every z with through w y z equals y. UltimateThroughAt m w x y means through w x y and that same no-distinct-source condition on y. UltimateSourceAt additionally asserts y exists at w and some x is ultimately through y. Neither a self-link nor necessity is assumed; self-link follows for a root under CoverageAt. The explicit actuality guard avoids giving a nonexistent candidate source status.
note: Typed analyst reduction of the primary Tapp reconstruction (§6,89–91), informed by the independently materialized Latin Monologion III. Not a defense of premise truth or a new identity of through with efficient cause.
